purpose: Bind current expectations to terminal Prose retirement, four active peer lanes, owner isolation, Programming continuity, and Knowledge Recovery 001 priority.

completion_expectations.requirement: PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired; it has no active work or execution domain.
SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain incomplete regardless of completed packets, tests, phases or subsystem evidence.
A system becomes complete only through explicit product-level completion authority; no chat, branch, workflow or phase may infer it.
PROGRAMMING is an incomplete active work program and is not an admitted peer system until explicit future authority establishes that boundary.

job_expectations.requirement: Integrate CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS without taking their product semantics; never resurrect a retired system.

Finish shared Foundation/Spine and integration primitives only; while Knowledge Recovery 001 is selected, prioritize Programming proving-corpus recovery then authorized catalog/archive recovery as highest discretionary work.
Finish Learning and integrate it upward into System Master without crossing Book, Documents or Programming product work or creating active Prose work.
Finish Book; own any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability as ordinary Book work; retain canonical Book authority; then integrate upward into System Master.
Finish Documents and integrate it upward into System Master for document/artifact mechanics; receive no Prose work.

Remain a Core-administered source/custody/provenance support subprogram and the highest discretionary System Master priority while control 001 remains selected; do not become the Programming product or a peer system.
Continue the existing Programming engineering work program from preserved evidence and prepare explicit System Master admission/integration without silent peer promotion or cross-lane ownership.

lane_expectations.requirement: The active peer owner lanes are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS.

Second Shift compares topology peer_system_ids with registry owner_files and auto-provisions missing coverage only for an already-declared peer when machine-resolvable; it never creates a new system or resurrects a retired one.
PROSE has no standalone, child, inherited, repair, qualification, research, telemetry, or successor execution. Historical Prose routes are stale and non-dispatchable.
Documents may provide generic document/artifact services to Book but may not absorb Prose, receive completed-Prose integration work, mutate Book canonical state, or take Programming engineering work.
Second Shift, repair routing, obligations, startup and current-state reconciliation fail closed on job/lane violations, stale owner heads, overlapping mutation claims, or retired-system resurrection.
Programming remains a named non-peer work program until explicit topology admission. It has no peer Second Shift lane and no peer telemetry ledger before admission.

authority_expectations.requirement: Exact-SHA, source-custody, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, native, external, publication and production boundaries are preserved across every reconciliation.
Changed topology or integration bytes require fresh evidence; no historical Prose or peer-system PASS transfers across changed subject or ownership boundaries.

carried_forward_expectations: All non-conflicting expectations from EXPECTATION-REGISTRY-004 remain historical/current guidance; this registry controls when there is a conflict about Prose lifecycle, priority, program job, work-program scope, lane ownership or auto-provisioning.
change_rule: Changing a system/work-program job, completion standing, retired standing, peer admission, ownership route or cross-lane exception requires explicit user direction and a current successor authority transaction.
